name: Starwon Enterprises
summary: Perth ISP 'Starwon Internet' (starwon.com.au); dialup, pricing/status/support portal; WAIA WAIX-class member; absorbed into the Perth ispX (formed July 2004 with Starwon, Karratha Internet and Netserv Connect).

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of starwon.com.au Dec 1996.
Absorbed into the Perth ispX, formed early July 2004 from Starwon Internet, Karratha Internet and Netserv Connect.
